task: Канал, возьми approved-задачу СЕЙЧАС: апгрейд распознавания (yolo11x = максимальная модель + порог уверенности + перепрогон на реальной камере device 0, новый proof). У тебя полный доступ — pip install и устройства разрешены. Юзер ждёт сравнение до/после.
goal: Upgrade the recognition system's performance by integrating the yolo11x model, optimizing confidence thresholds, and validating it on a real camera (device 0), providing a clear before/after comparison to the user.
constraints: Recognition system must use yolo11x as the maximum model.
Validation must be performed on real camera device 0.
New proof of improved performance is required.
A before/after comparison must be provided to the user.
known_context: Access to devices (specifically device 0) is permitted.
There is an existing recognition system that requires an upgrade.
The task is approved and ready for execution.
output_format: A comprehensive report or presentation detailing the 'before' and 'after' recognition performance, including quantitative metrics, visual examples, and the new proof of improvement.
success_tests: The recognition system on device 0 is confirmed to be running the yolo11x model.
A report is generated containing quantitative performance metrics (e.g., mAP, precision, recall, inference speed) for the recognition system 'before' and 'after' the upgrade.
The report clearly demonstrates an improvement in at least one key recognition performance metric (e.g., higher mAP, reduced false positives/negatives).
Visual examples (e.g., annotated images or video clips) from real camera device 0 are provided, showcasing the 'before' and 'after' recognition capabilities and highlighting the improvements.
The upgraded system successfully processes live input from real camera device 0 without errors.
